objectives.en: Explain the importance of understanding business environment
Relate each point to an Indian example

narration.en: Mobile phone makers who noticed that people wanted touch screens grew fast; those who ignored the signal disappeared. Watching the environment is a matter of survival.
narration.kn: ಟಚ್ ಸ್ಕ್ರೀನ್ ಬೇಡಿಕೆಯನ್ನು ಗಮನಿಸಿದ ಮೊಬೈಲ್ ಕಂಪನಿಗಳು ಬೆಳೆದವು; ನಿರ್ಲಕ್ಷಿಸಿದವು ಕಣ್ಮರೆಯಾದವು. ಪರಿಸರವನ್ನು ಗಮನಿಸುವುದು ಉಳಿವಿನ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ.

body.en: Understanding the environment helps a firm to identify opportunities early and gain the first mover advantage. It also helps to identify threats and gives early warning signals, so the firm can prepare before a rival or a new rule hurts it.

title.en: On the board: why study the environment

narration.en: Watch the board as we build this up step by step.

say.en: Think of the environment as a radar screen around the firm.
The radar shows opportunities, which give a first mover advantage, and threats, which give early warning.
Business is an open system: it taps resources from the environment and gives back output.
It helps the firm cope with rapid changes and plan its policies.
Together these improve performance in the long run.

narration.en: Match each benefit of understanding the environment to the example.

explanation.en: Knowing the environment gives first-mover advantage, warning of threats, access to resources, and better planning and performance.

right.en: A carmaker spots early demand for small cars and leads the market
A detergent maker prepares before a global rival enters India
The firm gets finance, machines and staff from its environment
Shops add online ordering when buying habits shift
A chain plans new outlets after studying incomes in small towns
Firms that track their environment closely do better over time

body.en: Business is an open system: it gets inputs such as finance, machines and labour from the environment and supplies output to it. Knowing the environment helps a firm cope with rapid changes, assists in planning and policy formulation, and improves performance.

points.en: Assisting in planning and policy formulation

narration.kn: ವ್ಯವಹಾರ ಒಂದು ತೆರೆದ ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆ; ಪರಿಸರದಿಂದ ಸಂಪನ್ಮೂಲ ಪಡೆದು ಉತ್ಪನ್ನ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಪರಿಸರದ ಅರಿವು ಬದಲಾವಣೆ ಎದುರಿಸಲು, ಯೋಜನೆ ರೂಪಿಸಲು ಮತ್ತು ಸಾಧನೆ ಸುಧಾರಿಸಲು ನೆರವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

problem.en: A Kolar dairy noticed that city families were buying more curd and paneer in small packs. It launched 200 g packs before any rival and became the market leader. Later, it heard that a big national brand planned to enter, so it improved its cold chain in advance. Identify the points of importance.

steps.en: Spotting the demand for small packs first: identifying opportunities and first mover advantage.
Preparing for the national brand: identifying threats and early warning signals.

answer.en: Identifying opportunities (first mover advantage), identifying threats (early warning) and improving performance.
